a02_f00e: Mr. President.
Europe will soon be asking us for help as well.
Yes, sir. I will take care of it.
It just does not seem right to me.
We should not have to ask anyone for help.
Premier Romanov has the whole of Europe trembling.
Romanov has sent his attack dog, General Vladimir,
against our air bases.
His forces are rampaging like a bull at a Texas rodeo.
At precisely 0500 this morning,
we detected a large force of Soviet tanks
massing near the Air Force Academy in Colorado Springs.
Sir, Special Agent Tanya has an urgent report from the field.
General, it looks like the Communists have taken the Academy.
Why did you wait until now to contact us?
We cannot let Vladimir hold that airfield.
Sir, for several reasons, we have been unable to act...
Commander, get Tanya out of that hole!
Give her something useful to do,
will you? I am sure she would appreciate it.
Oh, for...
It seems we have lost contact with Tanya.
Commander, get out there and bring her back.
a02_p01e: We have located a squad of Rocketeers in Colorado Springs.
They are ready to join us and await our orders.
